payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP over array positions and possible values 1..200, tracking two states (f0/f1) with prefix sums to optimize transitions satisfying neighbor constraints.
payload.rationale: The code iterates over positions, maintaining arrays for each value j; cumulative updates (nf0[j+1] = nf0[j] + ...) indicate a 2D DP (position, value). Other subtypes like 1d_state would not capture the position dimension. dp_counting_combinatorics is less specific as no combinatorial formula used.
